verdicts.reason: A keeps the original structure and hierarchy, but the SOLSTICE wordmark is centred instead of sharing the headline's left edge, and the subline is indented out of line. The subline, badges and button are also stacked too tightly, with an oversized button. B pushes the phone against the left and bottom edges, and the backing circle is cut off and runs behind the headline and copy. Its badge row floats about 150px to the right of the text column, which breaks the alignment and grouping, so A is clearly the better resize.
